# SmartChama
> Digital savings and loan management platform for Kenyan Chama groups.

## About
SmartChama is a fintech platform that digitizes informal savings groups (Chamas) in Kenya. It provides M-Pesa integration, loan management, merry-go-round scheduling, welfare funds, and AI-powered trust scoring.

## Features
- M-Pesa STK Push for contributions
- Internal group loans with 5% interest
- Merry-Go-Round rotating savings
- Welfare emergency fund claims
- SmartGrow investment proposals
- AI Trust Score credit scoring
- PDF financial statements

## Contact
Website: https://smartchama.vercel.app
